# pvecli tag list

List all tags in the cluster.

```text
pvecli tag list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-o`, `--order VALUE` | Sort by column (moved to first position), e.g. tag, vms, cts, total. |
